verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK is a programmatic Python/TypeScript library built for unattended runs. Its docs describe agents that find and fix bugs "without manual intervention" and production hosting in Docker, Kubernetes and sandbox providers. Permission modes and rules define what runs automatically, structured outputs give machine-readable results, and a community user reports building a full headless automated workflow around `claude -p`. Missing for 10: no explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g., a GitHub Actions or CI recipe), and only one thin independent report of headless automation.
